influences.name: Jimi Hendrix
influences.context: Meeting and working closely with The Who's Pete Townshend, and getting to chat with him about Hendrix – one of my biggest guitar heroes! – was a thrill.

influences.name: Brian May
influences.context: Another one is playing Bohemian Rhapsody with Brian May at the We Will Rock You London 8th Anniversary. Hearing my guitar alongside Brian May's on that song was quite a moment!
